name: Hoshino Spica
source: One of the chuuni girls, Spica believes to have come from space in order to monitor and observe the earthlings... or this is what she says, while spending her days as a normal high school girl. She doesn't show many emotions but can still hold decent conversations with people. Despite disliking violence, she loves to think about the destruction of Earth just in case the earthlings start acting weird.
